title: Discover
discoveryOff: Discovery is off. Turn it on in Deep profile or Privacy, then reload.
needAuthBody: Sign in to see suggestions from public profiles and record interest or pass.
emptyBody: No profiles match your current filters. You can complete your profile, adjust criteria, or check back later.
mutualToast: Mutual match — chat is open. Couple Space opens only after both people accept an invitation.
pageIntro: Explained suggestions from data you choose to share — not a love probability. A mutual like opens chat and does not create Couple Space.
flagOffBody: This feature is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
starterPrompt: Which book changed how you look at life?
v2Heading: Discover connections that fit your journey
v2Intro: Suggestions from data you choose to share — explained, never a love probability. Mutual like opens chat; Couple space only after mutual invite.
filtersHint: Soft ranking by default. Enable strict filters when needed.
compatExperimental: Experimental formula — not a scientific prediction
compatInsufficient: Not enough shared data to estimate a score.
collectionsHint: Counts from current results only — no invented stats.
emptyFilters: Filters are too strict. Relax them or turn off strict mode.
emptyActed: You’ve acted on everyone in this set. Come back later or relax filters.
emptyPool: No discovery-eligible profiles in the system right now.
emptyMediaGate: Add 3–10 photos (and at most 2 videos) before browsing Discover suggestions.
